name: SEDANIA
recent: 公司于2026年11月26日召开第12届年度股东大会，所有决议均获通过；同日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩，此外，公司于2025年10月完成私募配售，发行4260万股新股，并于2025年10月17日收到核数师对2025财年财报的保留意见。
notable: 2026年11月26日召开第12届年度股东大会，所有决议获股东通过。
2026年11月26日公布截至2026年9月30日止季度业绩。
2025年10月完成私募配售，发行4260万股新股，发行价每股0.148令吉。
risks: 核数师对2025财年财务报表发出保留意见，并提及与持续经营相关的不确定性。
私募配售发行4260万股新股，占扩大后股本约10.4%，对现有股东权益产生摊薄影响。
董事Datuk Noor Azrin Bin Mohd Noor在闭门期内外均有股份交易活动，包括2025年11月6日间接增持30万股。

news.title: Sedania Innovator Reports Q1 Profit Attributable To Equity Holders Of 2.04 Million RGT
Purchase/sale of investments (net) of Sedania Innovator Bhd. – MYX:SEDANIA
Stocks with momentum on Sept 8, 2026: UUE Holdings, Midtown Group, Sedania Innovator, L&P Global, KHPT Holdings, RichTech Digital, CB Industrial Product Holding

recent_en: The company held its 12th AGM on 26 Nov 2026, with all resolutions passed; it also announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026, with profit attributable to equity holders of RM2.04 million. Additionally, the company completed a private placement of 42.6 million new shares in Oct 2025 and received a qualified opinion from auditors on its FY2025 financial statements on 17 Oct 2025.
notable_en: Held its 12th AGM on 26 Nov 2026, with all resolutions approved by shareholders.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 26 Nov 2026, with profit attributable to equity holders of RM2.04 million.
Completed a private placement of 42.6 million new shares at RM0.148 per share in Oct 2025.
risks_en: Auditors issued a qualified opinion on the FY2025 financial statements, with material uncertainty related to going concern.
The private placement of 42.6 million new shares, representing approximately 10.4% of the enlarged share capital, diluted existing shareholders' equity.
Director Datuk Noor Azrin Bin Mohd Noor had share dealings during and outside the closed period, including an indirect acquisition of 300,000 shares on 6 Nov 2025.
